Why I Prefer the OPPO Enco X4 Over the Google Pixel Buds Pro 2

02 Nov 2026, 02:33 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.androidauthority.com

2 min read

Comparing Two Popular Wireless Earbuds

When evaluating modern true wireless earbuds, finding the right balance of comfort, sound quality, and features is essential. A recent comparative review highlights the practical differences between the Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 and the OPPO Enco X4, focusing particularly on ear fit, audio performance, and ecosystem integration.

Comfort and Fit

  • Google Pixel Buds Pro 2: While praised for their compact dimensions and sound quality, some users report challenges in achieving a secure, consistent seal with the stock eartips, which can impact active noise cancellation (ANC).
  • OPPO Enco X4: Designed with soft, pliable 'Low-Strain Noise-Cancelling Ear Tips' and weighing just six grams, these earbuds are reported to offer a stable, fatigue-free fit for extended listening sessions.

Audio Performance and Specifications

  • Drivers and Tuning: The OPPO Enco X4 feature a dual-driver system comprising an 11mm woofer and a 6mm tweeter, tuned in collaboration with Dynaudio.
  • Connectivity and Features: They support Hi-Res Audio, LHDC Lossless (when paired with compatible hardware like the OPPO Find X10 Pro Max), Bluetooth 6.1, dual connection, and IP55 dust and water resistance.
  • App Customization: Sound profiles can be adjusted via the Hey Melody app, available for both Android and iOS.

Smart Assistant Integration

Both models support hands-free interactions with Gemini Live using voice commands. While the functionality is largely comparable, one reviewer noted minor audio delay issues when using the feature with the Enco X4 compared to the Pixel Buds Pro 2.

Pricing and Availability

  • The OPPO Enco X4 are retailed at £219 in the UK, though availability varies by region, requiring potential importation in markets like the US.
  • The Google Pixel Buds Pro 2 launch price sits at around $230, though frequent promotional discounts often lower the price.

How to Verify

Consumers interested in these audio products should check official manufacturer websites, read multiple independent reviews, and verify local pricing and warranty terms before purchasing.
